    JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
    WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'
),
customer_genre_counts AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT g.GenreId) AS genre_count
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
    WHERE g.GenreId IN (SELECT GenreId FROM acdc_genres)
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
SELECT cgc.FirstName, cgc.LastName
FROM customer_genre_counts cgc
WHERE cgc.genre_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acdc_genres);

question: Which playlists contain tracks from more than 5 different artists?
sql:
SELECT p.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.ArtistId) AS artist_count
FROM Playlist p
JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN Artist a ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.ArtistId) > 5
ORDER BY artist_count DESC;

question: Which customers have purchased tracks from every genre that 'AC/DC' has tracks in?
sql:
WITH acdc_genres AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT g.GenreId, g.Name
    FROM Artist a
    JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
    JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
    WHERE a.Name = 'AC/DC'
),
customer_genre_counts AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT g.GenreId) AS genre_count
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
    WHERE g.GenreId IN (SELECT GenreId FROM acdc_genres)
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName
FROM customer_genre_counts c
WHERE c.genre_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acdc_genres);
